page_title: MET 0-1 MNT | Metz v Montpellier 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Dangerous play by Danley Jean Jacques (Metz). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Simon Elisor (Metz) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
90+4' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+1' Matthieu Udol (Metz) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+1' Matthieu Udol (Metz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Joel Asoro (Metz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
87' Metz fail to score from a corner as Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) leaps to collect the ball.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch so that Akor Adams can be given a rest.
86' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) replaces Jordan Ferri.
86' It will be a substitution. Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is ready to enter the pitch as Maxime Colin walks off.
85' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Simon Elisor (Metz) and blew his whistle.
85' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) is given a yellow card.
84' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) tries to find Matthieu Udol, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
83' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Alexandre Oukidja keeps it out with an amazing save.
79' It looks like Ibou Sane (Metz) saw red with that tackle. Marc Bollengier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
78' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is able to continue to play.
77' The game is interrupted now, Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Simon Elisor (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
75' Akor Adams (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but Alexandre Oukidja punches the ball away.
74' A corner kick by Metz is thwarted by the well prepared Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier).
74' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.

74' Joel Asoro (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
72' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Metz are going to take it.
72' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.
71' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Metz get a corner.
71' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
69' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' Surely that's handball by one of the Montpellier players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' Substitution. Mousa Al Tamari makes his way off the pitch and Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) comes on as his replacement.
64' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benjamin Lecomte intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Metz.
61' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Kevin N'Doram (Metz), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.
58' The free kick from close range, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marc Bollengier saw the whole situation. Metz are awarded a free kick.
55' Pape Diallo goes off the pitch and Joel Asoro (Metz) comes on.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pape Diallo (Metz) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
51' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared by the defence.
51' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Montpellier manage to earn a corner.
47' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Half-time substitution. Ablie Jallow (Metz) is replaced by Ibou Sane.
46' Laszlo Boloni makes a half-time substitution. Kevin N'Doram comes on in place of Lamine Camara (Metz).
46' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Lamine Camara (Metz) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
40' Metz couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
40' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Metz in a dangerous position.
37' Akor Adams (Montpellier) dribbles into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

33' A neat pass is well received by Akor Adams (Montpellier), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
32' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier. Montpellier force a corner. They send men into the box.

31' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Alexandre Oukidja to dive and make a save. Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' Rough tackle by Lamine Camara (Metz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
28' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but Alexandre Oukidja punches the ball away.
25' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joris Chotard (Montpellier).
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
24' Simon Elisor (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' The linesman signals that Simon Elisor (Metz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marc Bollengier no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Benjamin Lecomte steps in and intercepts a long pass from Maxime Colin (Metz).

20' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
19' Maxime Colin (Metz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Pape Diallo (Metz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' 0 - 1 The score has changed – 0:1. Teji Savanier sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) jumps highest and plants a header inside the left post.
9' The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
7' Lamine Camara (Metz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

6' Lamine Camara (Metz) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Metz.
2' Maxime Colin (Metz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Benjamin Lecomte, who smothers the ball.
1' The ball is cleared after Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Metz will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marc Bollengier.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
